38.title: Probe type - Ping.
38.description: Ping probe will use the route table to find the egress interface and next-hop for the defined probe targets. A ping echo-request will be sent out with the source IP of the egress interface. An echo response must return on the same interface within the response timeout limit. Otherwise, a missed probe is counted.

39.title: Probe type - TCP.
39.description: TCP probe uses the route table to find the egress interface and next-hop for the probe targets. A TCP/SYN packet will be sent to the target with a source IP of the egress interface. A successful response will be counted for each probe target when the target responds with either a SYN/ACK or RST via the same interface within the reply timeout limit. Otherwise, a missed probe is counted.
39.result:
Firewall will send the TCP/SYN packet every 5 seconds, and probes send will increase every packet sends out, when target replies either a SYN/ACK or RST, the Responses received count will increase.
When the host is unreachable, only the count of probes send will increase every 5 seconds, Led should turn red and the target status change to Down.

40.title: Probe type - Ping-Explicit Route.
40.description: Ping-Explicit probe bypass the route table, and uses the user-defined Interface and Gateway (optional) to send a ping echo-request. If no gateway is chosen, its assumed that the probe targets are directly connected on the defined Interfaces network.

41.title: Probe type- TCP-Explicit Route.
41.description: This probe bypasses the route table and uses the user-defined Interface and gateway to send a TCP/SYN packet to the destination with the source ip of the egress interface. If no gateway is chosen, its assumed that the probe targets are directly connected on the defined interfaces network.
41.result:
Firewall will send the TCP/SYN packet every 5 seconds, and probes send will increase every packet sends out, when target replies either a SYN/ACK or RST, the Responses received count will increase.
When the host is unreachable, only the count of probes send will increase every 5 seconds, Led should turn red and the target status change to Down.
